entry.name: icon
entry.label: Icon of the panel button: an icon name, or empty for the widget's own two-switches icon.

entry.name: previewPage
entry.label: For screenshots and tests: the page to show when previewOpen opens the panel ("bluetooth", "notifications" or empty).

entry.name: previewHideMedia
entry.label: For screenshots: show the media tile as if nothing were playing.

entry.name: previewOpen
entry.label: For screenshots and tests: open the panel as soon as the widget loads.
